title: DELETE /projects/<pid> has no authentication or authorization check
body: The GET handler for this same resource is protected with @require_auth, but delete_project (DELETE /projects/<pid>) has no such decorator or any other auth check before calling delete_project_row(pid). Any unauthenticated network caller who can reach this route can delete any project by guessing or enumerating pid values, causing irreversible data loss. Add @require_auth (and any needed ownership/authorization check) to this handler, matching the GET handler above it.
